message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Play** | 1. **Match**: On your turn, play one card that matches either the color, number, or symbol of the top discard.
2. **Wild**: You may play a Wild or Wild Draw Four at any time; you then declare the new color.
3. **Draw**: If you cannot play, draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | - **Skip**: Next player loses their turn.
- **Reverse**: Reverses play direction (two players → skip next player).
- **Draw Two**: Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
- **Wild**: Change the current color.
- **Wild Draw Four**: Change the color and force the next player to draw four cards. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; if challenged and found you had a match, you must draw 4 instead.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before your opponent takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins. | --- ### Quick Tips - Keep an eye on what colors your opponents are avoiding; that hints at what they might hold. - Use “Wild Draw Four” strategically—save it for when you’re sure you have no matching color. - In a 2‑player game, a Reverse acts like a Skip, so the next player is always the same person. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
